items.q: What did he have to hit?
items.a: $1,000 profit in 7 days, under $99 to start, and none of his own face or voice. He finished near $157 and said he would pay a commenter $1,000.
Amos led the mid-week check, so he got the workbook. On the last day Vivian, the account he dropped, had a clip over 250k views.
23 sales of a $12, 30-day habit workbook. $276 in, then $99 Higgsfield at list price and $19.52 PayPal. Claude and Stan Store were free.

items.q: Did he hide that they were AI?
items.a: No. Amos's bio says your AI grandpa. Comments still argued about Sienna as if she were a person. He calls an unlabeled seller a lie.
